meta.source: industrial-hmi-style-guide skill (High Performance HMI / ISA-101 baseline, ISA-18.2 alarm tiers, SEMI E90/E84 state mapping). Baseline values to adapt and sign off per site/product; no standard mandates exact hex codes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen background. Medium-light gray: no glare under control-room lighting, less fatigue than black over a shift.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and group frames that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-field
tokens.usage: Ground of operator input fields (entries, comboboxes, spinboxes) and table rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1px control and panel borders; 3.8:1 on surface, so borders carry meaning without color.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Equipment outlines, static piping and idle/unpowered shapes on Canvas; also the 1px border around alarm-colored fills.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Static labels and tag names on surface, surface-raised and surface-field (9.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Units, secondary metadata, timestamps on any surface (5.3:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Text of disabled controls only (WCAG exempts inactive controls; 2.8:1 on surface). Never for live data.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Live process values (numbers that change) on any surface, 6.3:1 or better. Tells live from static without being alarm-loud.

tokens.name: setpoint
tokens.usage: Operator-changeable values and the border of setpoint fields; 4.9:1 on surface. Signals 'you can change this'.

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Equipment running / step complete, used sparingly and never as a fill larger than an indicator; 4.8:1 on surface.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: solid 2px ring, 10:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: alarm-critical
tokens.usage: ISA-18.2 priority 1 (critical/emergency) only. Fill with on-alarm-critical text and a 1px outline border. Never used for anything that is not this alarm tier.

tokens.name: on-alarm-critical
tokens.usage: Text on alarm-critical (5.5:1).

tokens.name: alarm-high
tokens.usage: ISA-18.2 priority 2 (high). Fill with on-alarm text and a 1px outline border; always paired with a priority label, since it is close in lightness to alarm-critical.

tokens.name: alarm-medium
tokens.usage: ISA-18.2 priority 3 (medium/low), and E90 Aborted/Stopped/Rejected. Fill with on-alarm text and a 1px outline border.

tokens.name: alarm-advisory
tokens.usage: Advisory / informational notifications that need no action. Fill with on-alarm text.

tokens.name: on-alarm
tokens.usage: Text on alarm-high (7.2:1), alarm-medium (11.7:1) and alarm-advisory (5.6:1).

tokens.name: bad-quality
tokens.usage: Instrument fault / bad-quality value (the sensor itself is unreliable), kept apart from process alarms. Text on it is on-alarm-critical (6.5:1).

tokens.name: shelved
tokens.usage: Shelved, suppressed or out-of-service alarms: visibly not 'normal', never mistaken for an active alarm. Text on it is on-alarm.

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: E90 NotAcquired/WaitingForHost/InCarrier and E84 idle: nothing to act on.

tokens.name: state-active
tokens.usage: E90 InProcess/NeedsProcessing and E84 transfer in progress: expected, changing, not an alarm.

tokens.name: state-done
tokens.usage: E90 Processed and E84 transfer complete; E84 complete returns to state-idle after a short confirmation.

tokens.name: state-attention
tokens.usage: E90 Aborted/Stopped/Rejected: needs awareness, not an emergency by default.

tokens.name: state-alarm
tokens.usage: E90 Lost/Skipped and E84 handshake timeout. Must also raise a real ISA-18.2 alarm, not only color an icon.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: One per screen, top-left. Tk font size -20.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Static labels, button text, table text: the default UI font (TkDefaultFont). Tk font size -14.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Units, timestamps, secondary metadata. Smallest size on an operator screen. Tk font size -12.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Live values and setpoints in panels: monospaced so digits do not jitter as they update. Tk font size -16.

styles.name: value-large
styles.usage: Key figure on an overview tile (slot count, wafer count). Tk font size -28.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Carrier, substrate and lot IDs, alarm IDs. Tk font size -14.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a value and its unit; inner padding of indicators.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Grid pady between rows; button inner padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid padx between label and field columns; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; screen edge margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Separation between major screen regions (alarm banner, body, navigation).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for every ttk control, panel and table: Tier 1, native.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Canvas-drawn indicators and tiles (Tier 2): state lamps, wafer-map cells, load-port tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Canvas-drawn status pills (Tier 2). In Canvas, use half the pill height.

tokens.name: border-thin
tokens.usage: Controls, panels, outline around alarm fills.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width (focus-ring color).

tokens.name: border-alarm
tokens.usage: Blinking border of an unacknowledged alarm; the text inside never blinks.

tokens.name: blink-period
tokens.usage: Full cycle of the unacknowledged-alarm blink (two visible shades, never visible/invisible). Drive it with root.after on the Tk thread.

tokens.name: confirm-hold
tokens.usage: How long state-done stays shown after an E84 transfer completes before returning to state-idle.
